reviews.text: I lovee the mugwort line from roundlabs this is the second product ive tried the first one being the mugwort cleanser and i just love how effective this ingredient is for soothing the skin, calming down redness and moisturising. 10/10 skincare line for anyone with sensitive skin, personally prefer it over the birch line anyday.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意 roundlabs 嘅艾草系列，呢個係我試過嘅第二款產品，第一款係艾草潔面產品。我真係好鍾意呢種成分有幾有效，能夠舒緩皮膚、令泛紅平靜下嚟，同時補濕。對於任何敏感皮膚嘅人嚟講，呢個護膚系列係 10/10，我個人寧願揀佢而唔揀 birch 系列，任何時候都係。

reviews.text: I really love this toner. It provides gentle, lightweight hydration while leaving my skin feeling calm, soft, and refreshed. I especially like using it when my skin feels dry, sensitive, or a little irritated, because it gives my skin a comfortable boost of hydration without feeling heavy or sticky. It absorbs nicely into the skin and leaves it feeling smooth and balanced, which makes it a great step in my skincare routine. Overall, it’s a gentle and soothing toner that I really enjoy using every day.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款化妝水。佢提供溫和、輕盈嘅補濕，同時令我皮膚感覺平靜、柔軟、清爽。我特別喜歡喺皮膚覺得乾、敏感或者有少少刺激嗰陣用，因為佢畀皮膚一個舒適嘅補水效果，但又唔會覺得厚重或者黏膩。吸收得好好，令皮膚感覺順滑、平衡，所以係我護膚程序入面一個好步驟。總括嚟講，佢係一款溫和、舒緩嘅化妝水，我每日都好享受用。

reviews.text: The ROUND LAB Mugwort Calming Toner has been an incredibly soothing addition to my skincare routine, especially on days when my skin feels irritated, red, or sensitive. What I appreciate most about this product is its lightweight, watery consistency that absorbs almost instantly without leaving any sticky or heavy layer behind. The mugwort extract does a fantastic job of gently calming down inflammation and balancing out irritated patches, making it perfect to use right after cleansing or for layering when my skin needs an extra boost of lightweight hydration. It provides a very clean, refreshing sensation and works seamlessly alongside other active ingredients without causing any breakouts or clogged pores. While it is not a heavy-duty moisturizer on its own, it excels at its primary job of soothing and prepping the skin barrier. It is a wonderfully simple, effective, and reliable calming toner that I would highly recommend to anyone with sensitive or acne-prone skin looking for a gentle way to keep redness under control.
reviews.zh: ROUND LAB 艾草舒緩化妝水成為咗我護膚程序入面一個非常舒緩嘅成員，尤其係皮膚覺得刺激、泛紅或者敏感嗰啲日子。呢款產品最令我欣賞嘅，係佢質地輕盈、似水咁，吸收幾乎即時完成，唔會留低任何黏膩或者厚重嘅薄層。艾草提取物非常出色，溫和咁舒緩炎症，平衡刺激嘅斑塊，令佢非常適合喺潔面後即刻使用，或者喺皮膚需要多啲輕盈補濕時，作為疊搽嘅步驟。佢帶嚟非常乾淨、清爽嘅感覺，同其他活性成分一齊用都好順，唔會引起痘痘或者堵塞毛孔。雖然佢本身唔係重型保濕霜，但佢好擅長做到舒緩同預備皮膚屏障嘅主要功效。呢款係一款溫和、有效、可靠嘅舒緩化妝水，我極力推薦俾任何敏感或者易長痘、想溫和咁控制泛紅嘅人。

reviews.text: This toner has a very soothing and refreshing feel on the skin. The formula is watery and absorbs fast, making it a nice first step after cleansing. It helps calm redness and irritation while providing a light level of hydration. I love that it feels clean and non-greasy, so it also works well for oily or combination skin types. It’s a great everyday toner if you’re looking for something gentle and calming.
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝水用落皮膚感覺好舒緩、清爽。配方水潤，吸收好快，係潔面後好好嘅第一步。有助舒緩泛紅同刺激，同時提供輕度補濕。我鍾意佢感覺清潔、冇油膩，所以對油性或混合性膚質都啱。係一款好日常嘅化妝水，如果你想搵一款溫和、舒緩嘅產品。

reviews.text:
as promised after I wrote my Mugwart face wash review, I am now posting the toner review. Im always nervous with toners as they can really trigger irritable skin. so I was cautious. 
Just like its counterpart face wash, the calming Mugwart toner is soothing as well with no scent or irritation. I suggest just a bit on clean hands or fingers and patting on freshly cleansed face. cotton pads etc will flare red or irritated prone skin. In the directions it says just use hands to apply, no cotton swiping. So def do that. Just the act of a wash cloth wash or a cotton swipe undrenched in serums will irritate me. so this Round Lab line is a YES yes YES!!
reviews.zh:
因為我寫完 Mugwort 洗面奶評論之後，承諾會發表化妝水嘅評論，所以而家發帖。我對化妝水一向都好緊張，因為佢哋好易令易刺激嘅皮膚出問題，所以我都好小心。
就好似佢嘅潔面產品一樣，呢款 Calming Mugwort 化妝水都好舒緩，冇香味，亦冇刺激。我建議只係取少量放喺乾淨嘅手或手指上，然後輕拍喺啱啱潔面嘅面上。化妝棉等會令易泛紅或者易刺激嘅皮膚發紅或者不適。產品說明寫住，只可以用手塗抹，唔好用化妝棉擦，所以一定要跟足指示。用毛巾洗面或者用浸滿精華嘅化妝棉擦，都會令我刺激。所以呢個 Round Lab 系列，係 YES、YES、YES!!

reviews.text: I have been using this toner for a while now and I like it very much. It's very lightweight but not watery. I usually put it in a small spray bottle, I like it more that way because I feel loke if I put it on my palms and then on my face, some of it is wasted on my palms. It calms my skin and gives a nice base for my further products to absorb better.
reviews.zh: 我用呢款化妝水已經一段時間，好鍾意。佢好輕盈，但唔係水咁稀。我通常會將佢裝喺一個小噴霧瓶入面，我覺得咁樣更好，因為如果我倒喺手掌然後再拍喺面上，有啲會浪費喺手掌上。佢令皮膚平靜，又為之後嘅產品提供好嘅底，令產品更易吸收。

reviews.text:
For my skin, which is prone to both rosacea flare-ups and dehydration, finding a toner that genuinely calms and moisturizes without irritation is like striking gold. The ROUND LAB Mugwort Calming Toner has absolutely become a treasured part of my routine for precisely these reasons.

The star ingredient, Artemisia Vulgaris Extract (Mugwort), is present in a significant concentration, and its renowned calming properties are immediately evident. From the first application, I feel a comforting wave of relief on my skin. It's incredibly effective at soothing the redness and irritation associated with my rosacea, making my complexion feel less reactive and more balanced.

Beyond its exceptional calming abilities, this toner is a hydration champion. With Glycerin, Panthenol, Betaine, and Xylitol, it provides a substantial boost of moisture that my dehydrated skin eagerly absorbs. It leaves my skin feeling supple and plump, not sticky, which is a major plus. The "fast-absorbing formula" is true to its word, allowing for quick layering of subsequent products.

I also appreciate the inclusion of Madecassoside, a Cica derivative, which further enhances its soothing and skin-barrier supporting benefits. This comprehensive blend of ingredients works synergistically to nurture sensitive skin.

The ROUND LAB Mugwort Calming Toner is truly a stand-out product for anyone with sensitive, rosacea-prone, and dehydrated skin. It's a gentle, effective, and deeply soothing step that prepares my skin beautifully for the rest of my routine, consistently leaving it feeling calm, hydrated, and happy.
reviews.zh:
對於我嘅皮膚嚟講，佢易受玫瑰痤瘡（rosacea）發作同缺水困擾，搵到一款真正舒緩又補濕、而且唔會刺激嘅化妝水，就好似中咗頭獎咁。ROUND LAB 艾草舒緩化妝水，正正因為呢啲原因，已經成為我護膚程序入面一件好珍貴嘅產品。

主打成分艾草提取物（Artemisia Vulgaris Extract，即 Mugwort）含量好高，而佢嗰種出名嘅舒緩效果，一用就即時感受到。第一次用，我皮膚已經有一陣安慰嘅舒緩感。佢對於我玫瑰痤瘡相關嘅泛紅同刺激，舒緩效果非常好，令我皮膚睇落同感覺都冇咁容易起反應，亦更加平衡。

除咗佢出色嘅舒緩能力，呢款化妝水亦係補濕嘅冠軍。佢含有甘油、泛醇、甜菜鹼同木糖醇，為我脫水嘅皮膚提供大量保濕，皮膚好快就吸收晒。用完之後皮膚感覺柔軟、飽滿，唔會黏，呢點真係一大優點。「快速吸收」嘅配方名副其實，令之後嘅產品都可以即刻疊搽。

我亦好欣賞佢加入咗 Madecassoside（積雪草衍生物），令佢嘅舒緩同皮膚屏障支持效果更加好。呢個成分組合發揮協同作用，溫和照顧敏感皮膚。

ROUND LAB 艾草舒緩化妝水，對任何敏感、易玫瑰痤瘡同缺水皮膚嘅人嚟講，真係一款突出嘅產品。佢係一個溫和、有效、深層舒緩嘅步驟，為我護膚程序其他部分好好咁鋪路，皮膚一直都感覺平靜、水潤、開心。

reviews.text: It’s really light weight and yet it hydrates my skin really good, I love the drink like bottle, I think it’s adorable and really simple, also I like this ingredients for my sensitive skin, now that I’ve been through the most horrific breakout ever, this was definitely a really good and safe way to keep my skin hydrated and calmed.
reviews.zh: 佢好輕盈，但係非常補濕，我好鍾意佢個似飲品樽嘅樽身，好可愛同好簡單。另外，我鍾意佢嘅成分，適合我嘅敏感皮膚。我試過最恐怖嘅爆痘之後，呢款係一個非常好而且安全嘅方法，令我嘅皮膚保持水潤同平靜。
